message.content:
A magazine cover features the large black word "TEMPO" across the top third against a backdrop of a wooden sailing ship's masts, rigging, and sails. Smaller text above and below the main title includes "REFERENDUM ATAU OTONOMI KHUSUS DI PAPUA", "TARIK ULUR HILIRISASI BATU BARA", and "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU".

Centrally, a light-skinned man wearing glasses, a red headscarf, a brown vest over a white shirt, and a necklace looks towards a large, open wooden treasure chest. His hands are raised in open gestures near the chest, which is filled with pale, translucent, grain-like material. Behind him stand two other light-skinned men; one wears a dark bicorne hat and a grey coat, and the other a large black feathered hat and a blue coat. They are positioned in front of the ship's rigging.

The text "PARA PEROMPAK BENUR" appears in large white letters on the left, followed by a smaller paragraph beginning with "Penangkapan Menteri Kelautan dan Perikanan Edhy Prabowo...". The bottom left displays a barcode, QR code, and the date "30 NOVEMBER-6 DESEMBER 2020".
